systems_abstraction.rationale: The Art of War's structural organization into general principles applicable beyond any single battle is real, but attributing this specifically to a documented individual named Sun Tzu is unsupported — modern scholarship (per the World History Encyclopedia and mainstream sinological consensus) treats the text's authorship and its author's individual historicity as genuinely contested, possibly a composite work compiled and attributed later.

analytical_rigor.rationale: Same caveat as systems_abstraction — the text's own analytical structure is real, but cannot be confidently attributed to one documented biographical individual rather than a later compiler or tradition.

planning_orientation.rationale: As above; evidence about the text, not independently corroborated evidence about an individual's documented planning behavior.

holdReason: Cannot responsibly clear the 18-scored-attribute / average-confidence-0.55 eligibility floor. Nearly every specific biographical claim about Sun Tzu as an individual (including the well-known anecdote of training the King of Wu's concubines as soldiers) derives from a single source (Sima Qian's Records of the Grand Historian) written roughly three centuries after his traditional lifetime, and falls squarely under this rubric's own 'eccentric anecdote -> extreme score' anti-pattern even before considering it. Separately and more fundamentally, mainstream scholarship treats Sun Tzu's individual historicity and The Art of War's authorship as genuinely contested (possibly a composite/later-compiled attribution rather than one documented person) — see World History Encyclopedia. The only defensible evidence available describes qualities of the TEXT, not independently corroborated behavior of a documented individual, which cannot honestly support person-level trait scores at the confidence this rubric requires. Held, not rejected outright, in case future sourcing turns up stronger individual-level corroboration; not scored further to avoid padding with excluded anecdote-level or authorship-uncertain evidence.

provenance.notes: First-batch diversity pick that deliberately tests the HELD path honestly: ancient era, east_asia, military-strategy domain not otherwise represented. Genuinely held on evidence grounds, not forced through — a real demonstration that the pipeline's gates function, per the explicit instruction not to force all candidates to ACCEPTED.
